campaign: R33 mechanism emergence in generic learners
parent_evidence: POLAR Core v1.0 + R32 internal held-out transfer

success_rule.interpretation: Architecture-level median success requires stability plus material improvement in either post-burn closed-loop control or hidden-drift prediction, with the other metric no worse than 10% relative to CURRENT_MLP.

resolution_rules.strong_pass: At least two non-current architectures are successful; every successful architecture passes all D/C/R/A-like probes; at least one strict held-out architecture is both successful and DCRA-conjunctive; CURRENT_MLP negative control passes.
resolution_rules.partial: At least two architectures are successful; >=75% of successful architectures pass the full conjunction; no successful architecture passes <=2 mechanisms; CURRENT_MLP remains negative.
resolution_rules.counterexample: CURRENT_MLP is successful despite lacking history, or any successful architecture passes <=2 of the four mechanisms.
resolution_rules.inconclusive: Fewer than two capable architecture families or other primary conditions are not met without a direct counterexample.
